title: Curriculum Development In Nursing And Teaching-Learning Methods
modules: Application Of Teaching And Managerial Skills
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the general term for taking a class to the real thing in its context or normal surroundings."
A field trip is the general term for taking a class to the real thing in its context or normal surroundings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the learning theory that informs this curriculum approach."
Experiential learning is the learning theory that informs this curriculum approach.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in developing teaching skills in a simulated situation."
Micro-teaching is used in developing teaching skills in a simulated situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential element of critical theory."
Self-conscious critique is an essential element of critical theory.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relatively permanent change in a behavioral potentiality that occurs as a result of reinforced practice. (Hengenhann 1982) 6."
Learning is a relatively permanent change in a behavioral potentiality that occurs as a result of reinforced practice. (Hengenhann 1982) 6.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a need to make explicit the philosophical beliefs underpinning what the educational institution sees as worthwhile for learners to experience."
Central to making educational choices is a need to make explicit the philosophical beliefs underpinning what the educational institution sees as worthwhile for learners to experience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major task of the teacher."
Helping the students learn is a major task of the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for writing on the transparent sheets."
Special felt pens are used for writing on the transparent sheets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to response by action or a show of feelings."
Non-verbal refers to response by action or a show of feelings.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device or a model that represents a real-life situation and permits the student to interact with it in practicing skills relevant to that real-life situation."
A simulator is a device or a model that represents a real-life situation and permits the student to interact with it in practicing skills relevant to that real-life situation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a deliberate act of systematic planning of a set of interrelated activities usually between the learners and the teacher with a view to producing a desirable effect on the learners."
Teaching is a deliberate act of systematic planning of a set of interrelated activities usually between the learners and the teacher with a view to producing a desirable effect on the learners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a health worker who can practice at a defined level of proficiency in accordance with local conditions. 3."
The output of training is a health worker who can practice at a defined level of proficiency in accordance with local conditions. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a discussion session between a teacher and a small number of students."
A tutorial is a discussion session between a teacher and a small number of students.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to answering questions or reacting by speaking."
Verbal response refers to answering questions or reacting by speaking.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of morally acceptable assumptions about aims, correct and checkable assumptions about knowledge and verified assumptions about the effectiveness of methods."
A valid educational theory is one of morally acceptable assumptions about aims, correct and checkable assumptions about knowledge and verified assumptions about the effectiveness of methods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expert with a wealth of information which he/she must transmit to the learner."
The teacher is an expert with a wealth of information which he/she must transmit to the learner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tendency to behave or think in a certain way, e.g. respect for ideas that other people have."
An attitude is a tendency to behave or think in a certain way, e.g. respect for ideas that other people have.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the teacher, manuals, books, films, posters and models."
Sources of facts are the teacher, manuals, books, films, posters and models.
